comments.text: Ported in engine/src/gpu: Frustum, GpuResources, GpuShaders, GpuPipelines and GpuRenderer, with four tests in engine/tests/gpu (frustum, mip chain lengths, and Rust's two render_capture tests, which run on lavapipe here and skip without a GPU unless LANTERN_REQUIRE_GPU=1). Differences from Rust: shaders load from disk (LANTERN_SHADER_DIRECTORY, else ../shaders/compiled beside the executable) since Nox can't embed files; visible draws use an insertion sort; GPU debug mode defaults off rather than following the build profile. render_offscreen and new_offscreen are only for the world editor and move to L8.
